correctness.rationale: PASS. Joint ordered-pair 2-WL starts at equality/edge/nonedge and separates distance classes through 2^r after r rounds on cycles sufficiently longer than the interaction radius. For a rival union of cycles with shortest component m, s=ceil(log2 m), round s-1 diagonal profiles still match the connected C_n; at round s, a shortest-component vertex has far-color count n-m whereas a C_n vertex has n-1-2^s, differing by 1+2^s-m>0. The Pikhurko–Verbitsky exact diagonal 2-WL/counting-game bridge shifts first distinct diagonal round s to counting-quantifier depth s+1. Non-2-regular same-order rival graphs are separated by vertex-degree counting, and n=3,4,5 have depth 2. Independent implementation of canonical simultaneous 2-WL checked all 137 disjoint-cycle partitions for n=6..18 against s+1; finite enumeration supports, not establishes, the all-n proof.
